source:
I want you to create a game that is very similar to Slap Tower in terms of gameplay and overall design, but make it your own original creation and do not directly copy any assets.

Requirements:

- A high-quality map inspired by Slap Tower.
- An Admin Panel that only I can access.
- The ability to send announcements or chat messages to all players through the Admin Panel.
- The ability to start and stop events whenever I want.

Events I want:

- Speed Event.
- Jump Event.
- Volcano Event (lava rises and eliminates any player who touches it).
- Low Gravity Event.
- Fog Event.
- Darkness Event.
- Rain Event.
- Wind Event.

I want the UI to be clean, modern, and easy to use. Make sure all features and events work properly without bugs, and the game is fully playable.

answers.ask: No world theme was given - should the tower read as bright and stylized, or as a grim volcanic structure to match the lava event?
answers.answer: Make it bright and stylized, with an original colorful obstacle-tower look; the volcano event should be a temporary gameplay effect rather than the map's permanent theme.

answers.ask: Is the win condition reaching the top, or being the last player left on the tower?
answers.answer: The win condition is reaching the top of the tower.

config.genre_evidence: It is "similar to Slap Tower in terms of gameplay and overall design," implying a tower-climbing, skill-based platforming layout. The volcano event where "lava rises and eliminates any player who touches it" is a secondary survival hazard, not the main layout.
config.evidence: “very similar to Slap Tower in terms of gameplay and overall design” explicitly indicates a tower-style vertical obstacle course.
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Obby & Platformer map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Tower / Spiral Ascent: A course wrapping or stacking so platforms sit directly above each other.

INCLUDE:
- Sequential Platform Track: A chain of platforms spaced to the physics limits above — the ordered route through the course.
- Timed Obstacles: Platforms that vanish after being stepped on, or a set time after activation.
- Climb Obstacles: Trusses, ladders, tightropes, and wall scrambles.
- End Reward Area: A distinct reward area at the end of the course holding the payoff items.
